license_required.quote: An electrical installation may not be made unless by an electrician licensed by the board except as provided in this chapter.

exams.name: Written examination
exams.notes: Applicants must present a written application for examination and license; renewal may be made without further examination.
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure must present to the board a written application for examination and license containing such information as the board may require.

required.quote: All licenses may be renewed without further examination, upon the payment of the renewal fee as set under section 1203‑A and documentation of continuing education as established by rule as the board determines necessary.

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to any person who files an application, who is licensed under the laws of another state or territory of the United States and who has been licensed and actively engaged in an electrician's work for a minimum of 8,000 hours, as long as that state or territory has licensing standards and experience requirements at least equivalent to this State's and as long as that state or territory grants similar privileges to persons licensed under this chapter.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state or territory with equivalent standards, have been actively engaged in electrician's work for at least 8,000 hours, and the other jurisdiction must grant similar reciprocal privileges to Maine licensees. The board may waive the 576 hours of study required for journeyman or master license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making electrical installations without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who violates section 1201 is subject to the provisions of Title 10, section 8003‑C.

definition_quote.value: "Electrical installations" means the installation, repair, alteration and maintenance of electrical conductors, fittings, devices and fixtures for heating, lighting, power purposes or heat activated fire alarms, intrusion alarms, energy management, telephone, cable and closed-circuit television, sound systems, data transmission, conduit and raceway systems and electrically supervised manual fire alarms and sprinkler systems.
definition_quote.quote: "Electrical installations" means the installation, repair, alteration and maintenance of electrical conductors, fittings, devices and fixtures for heating, lighting, power purposes or heat activated fire alarms, intrusion alarms, energy management, telephone, cable and closed-circuit television, sound systems, data transmission, conduit and raceway systems and electrically supervised manual fire alarms and sprinkler systems.

methods_authorized.quote: "Electrical installations" means the installation, repair, alteration and maintenance of electrical conductors, fittings, devices and fixtures

license_tiers.quote: "Apprentice electrician" ... "Helper electrician" ... "Journeyman-in-training electrician" ... "Journeyman electrician" ... "Limited electrician" ... "Master electrician"

value: Entities subject to jurisdiction of the Public Utilities Commission, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, or Federal Communications Commission making installations in furtherance of authorized service
Aboveground electric transmission line work capable of operating at one kilovolt or more
Contractors performing services for public utilities to the extent the utility would be exempt
Electrical work and equipment in mines, pipeline systems, ships, railway rolling stock or automotive equipment
Installation or repair of portable appliances involving only insertion of an attachment plug into a fixed receptacle outlet
scope_exclusions.quote: The provisions of this chapter shall not apply to the following

utility_worker_exemption.quote: An entity subject to the jurisdiction of the Public Utilities Commission, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission or the Federal Communications Commission, including all employees of such an entity, but only to the extent the entity or its employees are making electrical installations in furtherance of providing its authorized service or activities incidental to that authorized service.
